claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: At 2.5 uM, HSP90 inhibition is unlikely to be the main driver of killing; the compound most plausibly causes broad, non-selective cytotoxicity through physicochemical/off-target effects such as cationic amphiphilic lysosomal stress or general protein damage.
